description: Use for sourced figures about stairlifts and home lifts in Germany: prices by lift type, the price index of published entry prices, the care insurance subsidy, KfW status, tax, running costs, minimum stair width rules, home lift prices, building code for lifts without a shaft, technical data, tests and studies (DISQ, Stiftung Warentest), statistics on care at home. Each fact comes with value, source, URL and check date from the fact register of treppenliftvergleichsportal.de.
name: treppenlift_fakten
title: Belegte Fakten zum Treppenlift
